kiss.$description: A thin line of light on the top edge, just before the top-right curve.

tertiary-decoration.$description: Text buttons are underlined so they read as tappable without color.

shadow-primary.$description: About half the card's light: one faint contact shadow away from the sun.

glass-ink.$description: Text on a glass button. Life Hub's marble is light in light mode and covered by the area's night layer in dark mode, so it follows the page's text color.
